output.summary: Group ticket time of about 17.6 minutes outside Riverside dates from the October 2024 menu redesign. The board knowingly accepted it (E4), and the same-month rise at all nine sites is consistent with that (E5). Satisfaction, repeat visits and sales improved afterward (E6, E7, E8). The 12-minute benchmark comes from a panel of pre-prepared-menu chains, so it is not comparable (E3). Par-cooked items cut food quality in the trial (E9). Riverside's jump to about 31 minutes traces to the unfilled saute/pasta vacancy, and group operations deferred two transfer requests (E10, E11). Why Delgado left is disputed (E13, E14, E15). Restore Riverside staffing and keep the scratch menu. Do not tie bonuses to ticket time (E18) or fire the GM.
